idea.title: CostRadar — Real-time LLM API cost tracker across providers

plan.tagline: Real-time cost tracker for LLM APIs across providers in your terminal.
plan.problem: Indie hackers and small teams waste money on unmonitored LLM API usage, leading to unexpected bills and no visibility into spending patterns.
plan.solution: Tracks API calls, costs, and usage in real-time with a Python CLI. Aggregates data from multiple providers, generates reports, and alerts when thresholds are exceeded—all offline-capable with --demo mode.
plan.target_market: Solo developers, indie hackers, and small businesses using multiple LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, etc.) who need cost transparency without complex dashboards.
mvp_features: Track costs per API provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
Real-time cost aggregation with per-call breakdowns

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: Implement SQLite schema for storing API calls, costs, and providers. Add commands to log calls and list entries.

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: Generate CSV reports by provider/time. Add threshold-based alerting via stdout or email (if configured).

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: Add --demo mode with hardcoded data. Improve --help, edge cases (e.g., invalid providers), and CLI polish.

plan.demo_script: Run `python costradar.py --demo`. Shows 3 hardcoded API calls (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral) with costs, a summary report, and a $100 threshold alert triggered by demo data.
plan.phuket_angle: Phuket-based digital nomads or small agencies using LLMs for client projects (e.g., chatbots, content generation) can monitor API spending to avoid bill shocks from fluctuating token costs.
